incident-bot: AUTOPAGE fired — pd_incident_id=PD12345 service=inference-gateway metric=5xx_rate window=2m value=6.4%
pagerduty: PagerDuty sent notification to: oncall-shift (policy: inference-gateway)
Sam R: acked the page :white_check_mark:
Sam R: looking at live charts — 502/503 spike from eu-west1 at ~12:07 UTC
Priya K: pulling edge-gateway logs now, grep for downstream 5xx and backend timeouts
Alex M: did we push anything to routing-service around 12:05? I see a config bump
Lydia S: queued rollback for canary but hold until we confirm root cause
oncall-shift: Sam R is oncall for infra right now
Sam R: quick dump of pods: ```
kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference-gateway
NAME                                    READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
inference-gateway-abc-123               3/3     Running   0          2d
inference-gateway-canary-xyz-456        0/3     CrashLoop 5          3m
```
Priya K: canary backend logs show repeated 503s from model-backend-v2: "upstream read timeout"
Priya K: suspicious log snippet: `2026-03-15T12:06:58Z ERROR upstream request failed: code=503 reason=kv-cache-miss warmup=false`
Alex M: that kv-cache-miss tag lines up with the remote model pull when cache got evicted after config change
Sam R: temp mitigation: scale ingress to reduce request queueing and re-weight traffic away from canary
Sam R: running commands: ```
kubectl scale deploy/inference-gateway -n prod --replicas=12
curl -X POST https://routing-service.internal/adjust -d '{"model-backend-v2":0.0, "model-backend-v1":1.0}'
```
incident-bot: Automatic fallback triggered: routing-service moved 40% traffic to model-backend-v1 due to health checks
Priya K: applied manual route adjustment too — now sending 70% to v1, 30% to v2 (canary throttled)
Sam R: metrics update: 5xx rate dropping 6.4% -> 2.1% in last 60s, p50 latency stable
Lydia S: any customer-visible errors? check enterprise tokens and heavy tenants
Priya K: quick count: `SELECT count(*) FROM request_logs WHERE status >= 500 AND tenant='acme-corp' AND ts > now() - interval '5 minutes'` -> 72 failures
Lydia S: flagged CSM and on-call support to do a brief customer check-in. DMing CSM now
Alex M: confirm deploy: there was a routing-service push at 12:04 that included a new cache eviction policy — rolling that back might help
Sam R: I can rollback the routing change to previous commit. Starting rollback: `git revert --no-edit abcdef12 && deploy/routing-service --env=prod`
Priya K: while rollback runs, increasing backend replica target for model-backend-v1 to absorb traffic
Priya K: `kubectl scale deploy/model-backend-v1 -n prod --replicas=8` (ok)
Sam R: PagerDuty: acknowledging and annotating incident PD12345 with short summary and mitigation steps
pagerduty: Incident PD12345 acknowledged by Sam R
incident-bot: Escalation check — ack received within 2m so no automatic escalation
Sam R: rollback of routing-service completed, canary traffic limited to 10% now
Priya K: canary pods stabilized, but warming still causing increased latency for v2; keeping most traffic on v1 until tomorrow morning canary test
Sam R: observing 5xx rate now at 0.6% and trending down to baseline; CPU across backends returned to normal
Lydia S: good. I'll run customer outreach: brief note to affected accounts and ETA for postmortem. @Priya K please include log excerpts for PM
Priya K: copy, saving logs + timeline to #postmortems/incidents and attaching grep output
Sam R: creating incident ticket PD12345 in Jira with labels: P1, inference-gateway, kv-cache, canary-release
Lydia S: scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Will include deploy timeline, routing-service diff, and suggested rollback gating
Sam R: resolution: traffic rerouted + routing rollback + scale-up mitigations. Marking as resolved in Slack thread for now. :white_check_mark:
Priya K: follow-up action items: 1) add canary throttling for cache-warmup 2) monitor tenant-level 5xx alerts 3) add playbook step to auto-scale backends on cache-eviction spikes
Alex M: I'll open PR with safe rollout flags for routing-service and add canary health probe improvements
Lydia S: thanks all. Closing thread.
summary: Autopage PD12345 for inference-gateway 5xx spike in eu-west1; oncall acked, routing rollback and traffic reweighting mitigated; customer impact observed (acme-corp ~72 errors), postmortem scheduled
